title: Thickness based on walls supported.
officialText: The thickness of foundation walls shall not be less than the thickness of the wall supported, except that foundation walls of at least 8 inch (203 mm) nominal width are permitted to support brick-veneered frame walls and 10 inch wide (254 mm) cavity walls.
